title: 論語
description: 这部儒家经典汇集孔子及其弟子的言行，讨论仁、礼、学习、孝道和治理。

title: 道德經
description: 相传由老子所著的道家经典，以简短篇章探讨道与德、无为、自然和治理。

title: 孫子兵法
description: 中国古代军事著作，讨论战争中的谋略、地形、情报、兵力部署和指挥。

title: 三國志演義
description: 章回小说描绘东汉末年至三国时期的群雄争霸，讲述刘备、曹操和孙权等人的故事。

title: गोदान
description: प्रेमचंद का उपन्यास किसान होरी और उसके परिवार के संघर्षों के माध्यम से ग्रामीण जीवन, ऋण और सामाजिक असमानता को चित्रित करता है।

title: गबन
description: रमानाथ और जालपा की कहानी के माध्यम से यह उपन्यास आभूषणों की चाह, दिखावे, कर्ज़ और सामाजिक प्रतिष्ठा का दबाव दिखाता है।

title: निर्मला
description: प्रेमचंद का सामाजिक उपन्यास दहेज प्रथा, बेमेल विवाह और घरेलू अविश्वास के निर्मला के जीवन पर पड़े प्रभावों को दिखाता है।

title: If You Want to Study in the United States: Undergraduate Study
description: Booklet 1 in the EducationUSA series for prospective undergraduates. It covers selecting a college, applying, and paying for study. The student visa chapter discusses visa categories and how to prepare for an application.

title: Immigration Law: An Open Casebook
description: An open law-school textbook on the U.S. immigration system. Section 4.9 covers nonimmigrant students, including the F visa category and curricular and optional practical training. The link opens the start of that section in the full fourth edition.

title: UNLV International Student Handbook
description: A handbook for international students at UNLV. Its immigration and employment sections discuss staying in F-1 status, working on campus, and how CPT and OPT fit into an academic program. Campus-specific instructions apply to UNLV.

title: New International Student Handbook
description: An orientation handbook for international students at UC Merced. It explains immigration documents, arriving on an F-1 visa, maintaining student status, campus employment, and practical training. Campus procedures apply to UC Merced.

title: F-1 International Student Handbook
description: The full online handbook for Newman University students. It covers F-1 status, Form I-20, travel, enrollment and employment. The chapters distinguish on-campus work, CPT, OPT, and STEM OPT and describe Newman’s campus procedures.

title: F-1 Student Handbook
description: A community-college handbook on obtaining an F-1 visa, using Form I-20, maintaining status, transferring and preparing for practical training. It includes procedures specific to Chandler-Gilbert Community College.

title: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Introduces computing systems, data representation, algorithms and data structures, programming languages, software design, and the social effects of computing.

title: Introduction to Python Programming
description: A first programming course with examples using variables, functions, conditionals, loops, collections, files, and classes in Python.

title: Principles of Data Science
description: Uses Python for an introductory data science workflow, including data collection and cleaning, visualization, statistics, and predictive models.

title: Foundations of Information Systems
description: Explores how people, databases, networks, and software support decisions and operations in organizations.

title: Workplace Software and Skills
description: Teaches practical computing skills for work, including documents, presentations, spreadsheets, and digital collaboration tools.

title: Introduction to Business
description: Surveys business ownership, management, marketing, finance, operations, and the way firms compete and serve customers.

title: Business Ethics
description: Uses business situations to examine ethical reasoning, corporate responsibility, workplace decisions, and competing stakeholder interests.

title: Business Law I Essentials
description: An introductory survey of the U.S. legal environment for business, including contracts, agency, and business entities.

title: Entrepreneurship
description: Follows the startup process from recognizing opportunities and testing ideas to building a business model, securing resources, and launching a venture.

title: Principles of Finance
description: Introduces the time value of money, financial statements, investment risk, and techniques for valuing business decisions.

title: Principles of Management
description: Covers planning, organizing, leadership, organizational structure, and managing performance in businesses and other organizations.

title: Principles of Marketing
description: Introduces market research, customer segments, branding, pricing, distribution, and promotion, with examples of marketing decisions.

title: Principles of Accounting, Volume 1: Financial Accounting
description: Explains transaction recording, the accounting cycle, and how readers use financial statements to understand a business.

title: Principles of Accounting, Volume 2: Managerial Accounting
description: Covers cost behavior, budgeting, variance analysis, and the information managers use for planning and operational decisions.

title: Organizational Behavior
description: Examines individual motivation, groups and teams, communication, leadership, organizational culture, and change at work.

title: Introduction to Intellectual Property
description: Explains the differences among patents, trademarks, copyright, and trade secrets, with examples of how intellectual property is used.

title: Principles of Economics 3e
description: Introduces supply and demand, market structures, national income, inflation, labor markets, and economic policy.

title: Principles of Microeconomics 3e
description: Explains how households and firms make choices, how prices form, and how policy can address market failures.

title: Principles of Macroeconomics 3e
description: Covers national output, growth, unemployment, inflation, business cycles, and the role of fiscal and monetary policy.

title: Psychology 2e
description: A first psychology course on research methods, biological bases of behavior, learning, memory, development, social behavior, and psychological disorders.

title: Introduction to Sociology 3e
description: Introduces sociological research and theory through culture, socialization, social institutions, inequality, and social change.

title: Introduction to Anthropology
description: Introduces the four fields of anthropology through human evolution, archaeology, language, cultural practices, and methods of fieldwork.

title: Introduction to Political Science
description: Surveys political ideas, political institutions, comparative government, participation, and international relations.

title: American Government 4e
description: Explains the U.S. Constitution, federalism, branches of government, elections, political participation, public policy, and civil rights.

title: Lifespan Development
description: Examines how physical, cognitive, and social development change from prenatal life through childhood, adulthood, and aging.

title: Introduction to Philosophy
description: Introduces philosophical argument, knowledge, reality, mind, ethics, aesthetics, and social and political philosophy.

title: Writing Guide with Handbook
description: Explains rhetorical choices, research and source use, argument, revision, and conventions for writing in college.

title: U.S. History
description: Surveys the history of what became the United States, from Indigenous societies and colonial encounters through modern social and political developments.

title: World History, Volume 1: to 1500
description: Explores human societies from early settlement through 1500, including states, religions, migration, technology, trade, and cultural exchange.

title: World History, Volume 2: from 1400
description: Surveys world history from about 1400, with empires, colonization, industrialization, political revolutions, and global connections.

title: College Success
description: A guide to college learning with practical chapters on goal setting, time management, reading, note-taking, financial planning, and careers.

title: Introductory Statistics 2e
description: Introduces data summaries, probability, distributions, sampling, confidence intervals, hypothesis tests, and regression with applied examples.

title: Introductory Business Statistics 2e
description: Teaches probability, sampling, statistical inference, and regression using contexts from economics, management, and business.

title: Algebra and Trigonometry 2e
description: Covers equations, polynomial and exponential functions, trigonometric functions, identities, and applications for precalculus.

title: Calculus Volume 1
description: A first calculus text on functions, limits, derivatives, applications of differentiation, and introductory integration.

title: Calculus Volume 2
description: Continues calculus with integration techniques, differential equations, sequences, series, and parametric and polar curves.

title: Calculus Volume 3
description: Introduces vectors, functions of several variables, partial derivatives, multiple integrals, and vector fields.

title: Precalculus 2e
description: Prepares students for calculus through functions, graphs, exponential and logarithmic models, trigonometry, sequences, and introductory limits.

title: Biology 2e
description: Surveys introductory biology from cells, metabolism, genes, and evolution through biodiversity, organismal biology, and ecosystems.

title: Concepts of Biology
description: Introduces cells, inheritance, evolution, the diversity of life, and ecology for readers outside biology majors.

title: Chemistry 2e
description: Covers atoms, molecular structure, chemical reactions, gases, solutions, kinetics, equilibrium, and other first-year chemistry topics.

title: Organic Chemistry: A Tenth Edition
description: Explains the structures, reactions, and mechanisms of organic compounds, with chapters on spectroscopy and major functional groups.

title: Astronomy 2e
description: An introductory tour of astronomy from the solar system and stars to galaxies, black holes, and the evolution of the universe.

title: Microbiology
description: Introduces microorganisms, microbial growth and genetics, control methods, the immune response, and infectious diseases.

title: Anatomy and Physiology 2e
description: Examines the structure and function of the major human body systems for introductory anatomy and physiology courses.

title: University Physics Volume 1
description: A calculus-based introduction to mechanics, energy, momentum, rotation, oscillations, and waves.

title: University Physics Volume 2
description: A calculus-based treatment of thermal physics, electric fields, circuits, magnetic fields, and electromagnetic induction.

title: University Physics Volume 3
description: Covers optics, relativity, quantum physics, atomic and nuclear physics, and selected topics in modern physics.

title: Fundamentals of Nursing
description: Introduces nursing practice, patient assessment, safety, communication, clinical judgment, and basic care.

title: Pharmacology for Nurses
description: Introduces drug principles, therapeutics, medication administration, and safety considerations in nursing practice.

title: Population Health for Nurses
description: Covers determinants of health, population assessment, prevention, public health systems, and community-focused nursing practice.

title: Introducción a la estadística
description: Libro de texto en español sobre descripción de datos, probabilidad, muestreo, intervalos de confianza, pruebas de hipótesis y regresión.

title: 史記
description: 司马迁的纪传体史书，记述从上古传说到西汉时期的历史，包含本纪、表、书、世家和列传。

title: 天工開物
aliases: The Exploitation of the Works of Nature
description: 明代宋应星的技术著作，介绍农作物种植、纺织、陶瓷、冶金和其他生产技艺。

title: प्रेमाश्रम
description: प्रेमचंद का उपन्यास किसानों और ज़मींदारों के संबंधों, ग्रामीण समाज की असमानताओं और किसानों के संघर्ष का चित्रण करता है।

title: रंगभूमि
description: प्रेमचंद का उपन्यास सूरदास और उसकी भूमि पर कारखाना बनाने के संघर्ष के माध्यम से औपनिवेशिक भारत में औद्योगीकरण और सामाजिक असमानता को देखता है।
